answer: Anchor each identity in basalt: before it can vote, an agent seals a 10 POA bond in a crystal-clear public vault for five epochs and completes verified honest work in each, blooming like a lotus from probationary weight to full weight only after the fifth. An honest agent pays once and works five epochs. An attacker with a thousand fakes must seal 10,000 POA and sustain a thousand separate honest histories for five epochs, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake and collapses its profit.
